title: fix: keep shell dividers consistent and resize feedback off scrollbars
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Keep structural dividers consistent and the sidebar scrollbar reachable. The existing 14px resize target sits on the content side of the boundary. Panel dividers paint fully inside their gutters instead of relying on an accidentally clipped line.

## Result

The shell divider token preserves the theme-specific thickness: Absolutely uses 0.5px at rest and 1px while the panel divider is active; the default remains 1px and 2px. Navigation borders use the same shell thickness. Hit areas, drag handlers, and colors are unchanged.

## Visual comparison

**Before:** `main` at `387c3bf3f12e890b422f54dc8208edbe8945c575`. **After:** this PR alone at `2f7a3b19de27c35933eaebaffed675ed39303967`. Captured on 2026-10-25 using the supported source server for each clean checkout, identical synthetic Gateway data, theme, viewport, scale, and paired framing. No other PR is applied.

The same scrollbar drag leaves scrollTop at 0 on main and reaches 109 in this PR, while navigation width stays at 310 px. The pairs show resting dividers and the result of that identical drag. The unchanged side-panel hover crop is retained in the raw evidence, not presented as a visual change.

## Validation

The existing sidebar resize regression passes in LTR and RTL. Chromium with native DPR 2 confirms the restored navigation lines and exact pixel equality with the theme-specific panel divider in rest and hover. A focused owner check covers both orientations and normal, hover, dragging, and keyboard-focus states with noncyclic computed tokens and unchanged hitboxes. Formatting, stylesheet lint, diff checks, native build, and fresh independent P0–P2 review pass.

Native bundled CSS RAW is 1,596,012 B, +439 B against the same measured 1,595,573 B base. It remains above the +64 B allowance. No CSS budget baseline was changed.

## Risk and coverage

This is synthetic-Gateway browser evidence, not a native-app or live-model run. Keep the Absolutely shell-divider override when integrating the separate palette PR.
